text:
MPC rose slightly today as oil refiners benefit from the current operating environment: US crude is trading at $97.26 a barrel while refineries are running at 97.8% capacity, near maximum utilization. The stock has climbed 8.91% over two weeks, riding a wave of volatility tied to the Iran war and its impact on global oil supplies—crude briefly topped $102 this week before retreating Friday on hopes of peace negotiations.

The recent uncertainty around Iran, Houthis attacking Saudi infrastructure, and conflicting signals about whether the conflict will end soon have kept energy markets unstable. Refiners like MPC tend to benefit when crude prices stay elevated and refinery utilization stays high, as they process more oil at higher margins, though the persistent geopolitical tension means these gains could reverse quickly if a ceasefire actually takes hold.
